description.value: Birdie Indoor Golf Center is the first venue in Canada to offer GreenJoy golf simulators to the public, featuring 7 open bays and 3 private VIP rooms where visitors can play world-class courses rain or shine. The facility includes professional golf instruction, active tournaments, and a lounge with bar and food service. It operates as a multi-location brand with the Richmond site being the flagship open location.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website for birdiegolfcenter.com/richmond/ is fully accessible and confirms address (4280 Number 3 Rd, Richmond, BC V6Y 0C2), phone (236-466-1466), free Wi-Fi, and food/drink service. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, showers, or any cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the content. The facility is an indoor golf simulator lounge — a legitimate attraction but with no confirmed cycling-relevant infrastructure beyond free parking (car-centric) and Wi-Fi.
concerns: OSM phone field is empty; phone number 236-466-1466 sourced from website only, not cross-checkable against OSM.

Business operates under two name variants across the site: 'Birdiegolf Center' (logo/footer) and 'Birdie Indoor Golf Center' (page titles and contact page) — OSM name matches the formal title used in page headings.
No cycling infrastructure (bike parking, washrooms, water) mentioned anywhere on the website; all required criteria are unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Birdie Indoor Golf Center is a legitimate open business in Richmond but is an indoor golf entertainment venue with no confirmed cycling-specific amenities; its relevance to cycling tourism is marginal and warrants human judgement on whether it belongs in the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free parking is explicitly listed as an amenity, suggesting a car-centric venue. Coquitlam and Brentwood locations listed as 'COMING SOON'; Metrotown location at 5318 Imperial St, Burnaby is separately open.

Café or food on site.detail: Website lists 'Bar Service Available' and 'Food & Drink' under Features & Amenities

wow_evidence: Golf simulator lounge — rainy-day activity, first-in-Canada equipment claim noted but niche.
blurb: Golf simulator lounge with bar and instruction.
